name: Taloraan
description: Taloraan was a gas giant that contained a life zone. Located in the Taloraan system in the Expansion Region and the Interior in grid square I-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid, it was home to the Wind Raiders. While living as a hermit on the planet Pasaana, Lando Calrissian wore a Taloraan Wind Raider's helmet, given to him by Komat. He also wore a coat with a collar insulated with Fleft-wauf pattern.
